title: Challenge 2.1: Complete Diagnostic Suite Configuration
description: Create a fully configured diagnostic suite with ALL Settings features.

story.setup: MENTOR-9: "PROTO-7, it's time to put it all together. Create a COMPLETE diagnostic suite with every Settings feature we've learned."
story.context: This challenge combines: Documentation, Suite Setup/Teardown, Test Setup/Teardown, Default Tags, Test Timeout, and Library Imports into one cohesive suite.
story.success: MENTOR-9: "OUTSTANDING! You've built a production-ready diagnostic suite. This is how professional Robot Framework tests are configured!"

instructions: Create the *** Settings *** section with ALL of the following:
1. Documentation: 'Complete Diagnostic Suite - All Systems Check'
2. Suite Setup that logs: 'Initializing diagnostic framework'
3. Suite Teardown that logs: 'Diagnostic framework shutdown complete'
4. Test Setup that logs: 'Preparing test environment'
5. Test Teardown that logs: 'Cleaning test environment'
6. Default Tags with two tags: 'diagnostic' and 'automated'
Create the *** Test Cases *** section with TWO test cases:
Test Case 1: 'Core Systems Check' - Log 'Core systems operational'
Test Case 2: 'Power Systems Check' - Log 'Power systems operational'
Watch the execution order in the log to see all lifecycle hooks in action!
hints: All settings go in the *** Settings *** section at the top
Order matters for readability: Documentation first, then hooks, then tags/timeout, then libraries
Each test will have: Suite Setup → Test Setup → Test Code → Test Teardown → Suite Teardown (after last test)
Both tests inherit the default tags automatically
solution:

theory.title: Challenge 2.1: Complete Suite Configuration
theory.content:
🎯 The Complete Configuration

MENTOR-9: "PROTO-7, you've learned all the Settings components. Now combine them into one production-ready diagnostic suite!"

"This is how real Robot Framework test suites are built - comprehensive configuration, proper lifecycle management, organized execution."

🔧 Complete Settings Checklist

Documentation & Metadata:

  • ✅ Documentation - Describe the suite's purpose
  • ✅ Default Tags - Categorize all tests

Lifecycle Hooks:

  • ✅ Suite Setup - Initialize once before all tests
  • ✅ Suite Teardown - Cleanup once after all tests
  • ✅ Test Setup - Prepare before each test
  • ✅ Test Teardown - Cleanup after each test

Safety & Extensions:

  • ✅ Test Timeout - Prevent hanging tests
  • ✅ Library Imports - Load additional functionality

📝 Execution Flow

With this complete configuration, here's what happens:

  1. 🔹 Suite Setup: "Initializing diagnostic framework" (once)
  2. 🔹 Test Setup: "Preparing test environment" (test 1)
  3. 🔹 Core Systems Check: "Core systems operational"
  4. 🔹 Test Teardown: "Cleaning test environment" (test 1)
  5. 🔹 Test Setup: "Preparing test environment" (test 2)
  6. 🔹 Power Systems Check: "Power systems operational"
  7. 🔹 Test Teardown: "Cleaning test environment" (test 2)
  8. 🔹 Suite Teardown: "Diagnostic framework shutdown complete" (once)

🏆 Challenge Requirements

  • 🔹 ALL 8 Settings features must be present
  • 🔹 TWO test cases must be created
  • 🔹 Proper syntax and indentation throughout
  • 🔹 Both tests must pass (within 45-second timeout)
  • 🔹 Tags applied automatically to both tests

🎯 Your Challenge

Build a complete diagnostic suite with every Settings feature. Check the execution log to see the beautiful choreography of lifecycle hooks!
